claim_verdicts.C1: partial: within-model amplitude intervention is verified and reduces v-only repair costs; loss-related amplitude-versus-direction attribution is not fully isolated
claim_verdicts.C2: no: every attenuation setting fails the frozen joint cost-and-variation retention gate

what_results_support: All 400 TRAIN candidates and 80 paired three-amplitude proposal groups were independently checked from saved JSON; source input hashes match.
v025 and v050 reduce coupled queries by 21.7877% and candidate time by approximately 20.25% relative to v100, with unchanged 40/40 eligibility.
g100 improves on v100 at full amplitude in this fixed TRAIN setting, while additional attenuation provides no meaningful cost benefit.
All ten methods meet the frozen stability gate; all twenty preselected execution/replay reports pass, and selections/reference hashes match saved eligible candidates.
The goal-loss residual differs in both amplitude and direction; normalized pose-change-per-residual is a descriptive mechanism clue only.
what_results_dont_support: No attenuation preserves at least 80% of final pairwise RMS while satisfying the other C2 requirements.
No overall superiority over the exact pretrained learned mean or the cost/variation tradeoff of mean-plus-bow is established.
No useful obstacle-route, homotopy, or multimodal coverage is established by control-point RMS and greedy distinct counts.
No raw-sample full feasibility, all-candidate execution certification, independent generalization, or hardware validation is established.
No new training, dataset expansion, or completion of the full goal occurred in this round.
missing_evidence: Prospectively amplitude-matched comparisons separating residual-direction benefit from shrinkage and nonlinear processing.
A qualified stochastic residual that adds useful world-target coverage at justified total cost against the pretrained conditional mean and a reasonable nonneural stochastic baseline.
Actual additional qualified TRAIN arrays and verified training ingestion across new target/scene conditions after data-quality and stability gates.
Independent development families, at least three preset sampling seeds, and different training seeds for reproducible confirmation.
suggested_claim_revision: On eight previously trained fixed world targets, residual attenuation reduces v-only repair cost by shrinking output variation; all attenuation settings fail the preregistered cost-and-variation preservation gate. Goal-loss training changes residual amplitude and direction, but useful target-preserving stochastic coverage and reproducible superiority remain unestablished.
next_experiments_needed: One bounded world-target-qualified residual-learning and TRAIN coverage-increment stage: freeze one target-preserving representation/denoising change; retain the pretrained learned mean, mean-plus-bow/nonneural stochastic control, strong spline and current g100; compare at matched amplitude where causal direction attribution is intended.

After prospective data-quality/stability checks, execute a predefined small TRAIN expansion across target/scene conditions with actual arrays, provenance, failures, deduplication against prior same-goal labels, training-ingestion verification and stratified preselected execution; measure accepted incremental coverage per total cost. Preserve existing authorization limits and do not automatically start pilot/study/strict_multimodal/TEST/production.
After that focused stage, freeze independent-development multi-seed confirmation before claiming reproducible superiority.
confidence_scope: Local evidence arithmetic and the partial/no gate decision, not success of future methods or generalization.
provisional_label: provisional — no paper claim audit available
routing_action: supplement: focused world-target-qualified residual learning plus gated bounded TRAIN coverage expansion

audit.timing_note: Two timing levels differ by 6.251266 seconds; per-method comparisons use saved candidate internal wall times consistently. Neither is total system time.
audit.mean_zero_cost_caveat: Five repeated proposals were correctly charged, but this is not an optimal practical cached/early-stop cost.
